sql:
SELECT
    pc.ProductCategoryName,
    count() AS product_count
FROM retail.DimProduct p
INNER JOIN retail.DimProductSubcategory ps
    ON toInt32(p.ProductSubcategoryKey) = ps.ProductSubcategoryKey
INNER JOIN retail.DimProductCategory pc
    ON ps.ProductCategoryKey = pc.ProductCategoryKey
GROUP BY pc.ProductCategoryName
ORDER BY product_count DESC, pc.ProductCategoryName ASC
